title: Intangible Assets–Web Site Costs
summary: Addresses the accounting for website development costs, confirming that a website is an internally generated intangible asset subject to IAS 38's recognition criteria, with planning stage costs expensed and development stage costs conditionally capitalised.

related.title: Intangible Assets
related.relationship: The parent standard SIC-32 applies directly to website development costs, including the research/development split and general recognition criteria

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: Governs the hardware (servers, network equipment) used to host and operate the website, outside SIC-32's scope

related.title: Inventories
related.relationship: Applies instead where a website is developed for SALE to a customer, rather than for the entity's own use
